title: Battle Tung Tung Sahur 2Player
label: 2 Player Battle
editorial: A two-player arena contest built around direct competition and short rounds. Two teams fight for control of the chest, making this a good pick for simple local battle rather than a long campaign.
controls: Use the on-screen keyboard prompts; the game is designed around two-player input.
audience: Players looking for quick, local two-player action.
whySelected: It adds a clearly competitive two-player format to the action collection.
howToPlay: Move into the arena, challenge the other player and hold the chest longer than your opponent.

title: Collect Brainrot Arena
label: Multiplayer Arena
editorial: A chaotic arena game where collecting, stealing and protecting your base compete for attention. Lucky Blocks, collection upgrades and rival pressure give the action lane a more tactical multiplayer angle.
controls: Use movement and interaction controls shown in the game screen; timing your runs matters.
audience: Players who enjoy competitive collecting, risk and quick tactical decisions.
whySelected: It brings objective-based arena play and collection strategy beyond standard shooting.
howToPlay: Collect Lucky Blocks, unlock Brainrots, improve your collection and protect your base from rival thieves.

title: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3
label: 3v3 PvP Arena
editorial: A colorful 3v3 PvP arena built around team battles, character abilities and different fighting styles. Its team format contrasts with solo shooters and tank games.
controls: Move, attack and activate abilities using the controls displayed in the game.
audience: Players who prefer colorful team battles over solo play.
whySelected: It gives the PvP collection a clear team-based arena identity.
howToPlay: Choose a slime character, learn its ability set and work with your team to win arena battles.

title: Shooter Zombie Survival
label: Zombie Waves / Upgrade
editorial: A wave-based zombie shooter with a clear upgrade loop: survive attacks, earn cash, improve weapons and work toward the final wave. It is a straightforward action pick for short sessions.
controls: Use the movement and aiming controls shown in the game screen; keep distance from the waves.
audience: Players who enjoy accessible zombie action and weapon upgrades.
whySelected: It adds progression and survival pressure to the action collection.
howToPlay: Fight zombie waves, collect cash and buy weapon upgrades before the next challenge.

title: Elemental Barrage
label: Aim / Elemental Tactics
editorial: A compact tactical shooter-puzzle in which monsters advance row by row. Aim elemental balls, use bounce angles and combine burn, freeze and chain-lightning upgrades to control the board.
controls: Drag and release with mouse or touch input; read the board before committing a shot.
audience: Players who like short tactical puzzles with visible cause and effect.
whySelected: It fits mini strategy through positioning, timing and upgrade choices.
howToPlay: Drag to aim, release the elemental barrage and use pickups to create stronger combinations.

title: Gift Of Alchemy
label: Alchemy / Puzzle Strategy
editorial: A fantasy alchemy experience centered on rediscovering a lost art. It is a slower, more thoughtful fit for the strategy collection and a change of pace from arena combat.
controls: Use click or touch interactions shown on the game screen to combine and progress.
audience: Players who prefer calm fantasy puzzles to fast action.
whySelected: It broadens the strategy lane with a puzzle-like fantasy theme and deliberate decisions.
howToPlay: Experiment with the available alchemy interactions and follow the discovery path to revive the craft.

title: Among Dungeon
label: Arcade Survival / Levels
editorial: A compact level-based survival platform game with hazards and a clear goal: make it from one side of each level to the other. It is suited to short, readable challenges.
controls: Use the directional and action controls shown in the game; careful movement beats rushing.
audience: Players looking for short platform survival challenges.
whySelected: It adds a lightweight survival and route-planning experience to the strategy-adjacent collection.
howToPlay: Move through each level, avoid hazards and reach the exit while managing the timing of your steps.

title: Ramp Truck Mayhem
label: Monster Truck Stunts
editorial: A stunt-focused monster truck game built around wooden ramps, airtime and landing control. The checkered flag gives each run a clear finish while jumps provide replayable challenge.
controls: Use the drive and balance controls shown in the game; adjust timing before each jump.
audience: Players who enjoy monster trucks, stunts and quick retry loops.
whySelected: It strengthens the off-road identity with a focused stunt and momentum loop.
howToPlay: Launch the truck from ramps, manage airtime and land safely while pushing toward the finish.

title: Animal Racing 2
label: Arcade Racing / Transform
editorial: An arcade race with a playful twist: run against opponents, transform between animals and solve quick movement challenges. It is lighter and more experimental than a standard car racer.
controls: Use the movement and transformation controls displayed in the game.
audience: Players who want colorful arcade racing with unusual mechanics.
whySelected: It adds variety to racing with transformation mechanics and obstacle-based decisions.
howToPlay: Run the course, respond quickly to transformation prompts and outsmart opponents across the route.

title: Snow Plow Jeep Simulator
label: Driving Simulator / Snow
editorial: A driving-simulation choice with a practical objective: clear snowy roads in a mountainous town. Its work-focused format gives the off-road collection a different rhythm from stunt racing.
controls: Use the driving controls shown in the game; plan turns carefully in narrow or slippery areas.
audience: Players who enjoy vehicle simulators and task-based driving.
whySelected: It expands the category from racing alone into driving challenges and vehicle simulation.
howToPlay: Drive the snow plow through the town, clear the routes and manage the vehicle across snowy terrain.

title: Winter Monster Trucks Race
label: Monster Truck / Upgrade
editorial: A winter monster-truck racer with coin collection, level progression and vehicle upgrades. Its clear arcade structure is easy to understand and suitable for repeat attempts.
controls: Use the acceleration and steering controls shown in the game.
audience: Players who want accessible monster-truck racing with progression.
whySelected: It gives racing a traditional level-and-upgrade loop with a seasonal off-road setting.
howToPlay: Drive through winter tracks, collect coins and upgrade the monster truck as you clear levels.

title: Last Garage: Zombie Road
label: Zombie Driving / Survival
editorial: A driving-survival game that combines road navigation with zombie threats. Move through changing districts, avoid wrecks and barriers, and use vehicle weapons against larger enemies.
controls: Use the driving and weapon controls displayed in the game; watch the road before engaging enemies.
audience: Players who like vehicle combat, zombie survival and action driving.
whySelected: It connects racing and tactical survival through driving, route reading and threat management.
howToPlay: Drive through each district, avoid obstacles and use the vehicle weapons when enemies block the route.
